q: How many complaints are there for the F-150?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM complaints WHERE model = 'F-150'

q: How many Escape complaints involve a crash?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM complaints WHERE model = 'ESCAPE' AND crash = 1

q: Which component has the most complaints for the Explorer?
gold: SELECT component FROM complaints WHERE model = 'EXPLORER' GROUP BY component ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

q: How many recall records are on file for the Bronco Sport?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recalls WHERE model = 'BRONCO SPORT'

q: Which F-150 model year has the most complaints?
gold: SELECT model_year FROM complaints WHERE model = 'F-150' GROUP BY model_year ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

q: How many Mustang Mach E complaints report at least one injury?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM complaints WHERE model = 'MUSTANG MACH E' AND injured > 0

q: How many complaints were received in 2025 across all models?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM complaints WHERE received_date >= '2025-01-01' AND received_date <= '2025-12-31'

q: Which five states have the most complaints?
gold: SELECT state FROM complaints GROUP BY state ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 5

q: How many distinct components have complaints for the Escape?
gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT component) FROM complaints WHERE model = 'ESCAPE'

q: How many complaints involve a fire?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM complaints WHERE fire = 1

q: What is the earliest recall report date for the Explorer?
gold: SELECT MIN(report_date) FROM recalls WHERE model = 'EXPLORER'

q: How many Bronco Sport engine complaints are there?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM complaints WHERE model = 'BRONCO SPORT' AND component = 'ENGINE'

q: Which model has the most complaints?
gold: SELECT model FROM complaints GROUP BY model ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

q: How many complaints are there for model year 2021 Explorers?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM complaints WHERE model = 'EXPLORER' AND model_year = 2021

q: How many Explorer recall records concern seats?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recalls WHERE model = 'EXPLORER' AND component = 'SEATS'

q: How many complaints mention stalling?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM complaints WHERE LOWER(description) LIKE '%stall%'

q: How many complaints were received in September 2026?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM complaints WHERE received_date >= '2026-09-01' AND received_date <= '2026-09-30'

q: Which component of the Mustang Mach E has the most complaints?
gold: SELECT component FROM complaints WHERE model = 'MUSTANG MACH E' GROUP BY component ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

q: How many recall records were reported in 2026?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recalls WHERE report_date >= '2026-01-01' AND report_date <= '2026-12-31'

q: For each model, how many complaints involve a crash?
gold: SELECT model, COUNT(*) FROM complaints WHERE crash = 1 GROUP BY model
